entries.title: Diamonds 2.0 Demo
entries.summary: Guide a bouncing ball through Diamonds' colorful block puzzles.
entries.limits: Original Diamonds 2.0 demonstration. Keep the complete package and its original notices.

rights.permission: The original Diamonds 2.0 Demo launcher states, "Diese Demo-Version kann unbeschränkt kopiert und weitergegeben werden" (this demo version may be copied and passed on without restriction). The archive contains only the demo application and its two background files.
rights.notes: Unchanged 184,315-byte StuffIt archive, SHA-256 dfec8d30230938fd08e6da101956a8cee7f1f7f2a64282a09275f1eea910d9be. The German demo splash credits das softwarehaus GmbH as its distributor.

entries.title: GNU Chess Mac 4.0b5
entries.summary: Play chess against the Macintosh port of GNU Chess, with an opening book, adjustable clocks and a move list.
entries.limits: Original GPLv2 Macintosh 4.0b5 package, 68K only. Select Options → Easy before playing. Preserve all notices; matching source is available below.
entries.content_guidance: Traditional chess board game; no wagering

rights.rights_holder: GNU Chess authors and Macintosh port contributors
rights.permission: The retained ReadMe explicitly identifies GNU licensing and free distribution; the complete original COPYING supplies GNU GPL version 2. Preserve the entire unchanged package, licence and notices. The complete matching original source archive is supplied as a managed supplement alongside this binary.
rights.notes: Original MD5 2a5accfbf4598956b4e07c173abac4b9. All retained binary and matching-source data/resource notices were reviewed. Independent production packing matches all five paths, ten forks and five Finder records against unar/lsar with strict end validation. The original fat executable has CODE 0-3, cfrg 0 and a PowerPC PEF data fork; only 68K is presently qualified.

rights.rights_holder: GNU Chess authors and Macintosh port contributors
rights.permission: Complete matching original Mac 4.0b5 source, including C sources, Macintosh UI, projects, bitmap resources and COPYING. Retain the unchanged archive alongside the binary. Source notices affirm GPL copying; source and binary COPYING documents are identical complete GPLv2 texts.
rights.notes: Original MD5 0fd91dbf63f9ea8a286a4fab3a1cb43a. Independent production packing matches all 39 source paths, 78 forks and 39 Finder records against unar/lsar, including resource-only project files, with strict end validation.

entries.title: MacGnuGo
entries.summary: Play Go on a full-size board against the GNU Go 2.6 engine.
entries.limits: Original GPLv2 MacGnuGo 0.5 GUI and GNU Go 2.6 package, 68K. This historical version has original gameplay limitations; Mac sources are included and matching engine source is available below.
entries.content_guidance: Traditional Go board game; no wagering

rights.license: GNU GPL version 2 and original Mac source-retention notice
rights.rights_holder: Jeremy Harris; GNU Go authors; retained third-party notices
rights.permission: The complete README_code explicitly permits distribution anywhere provided the code and message accompany the application. The original full COPYING supplies GPLv2. Preserve both original frontends, all MacCode sources, patches, resources and notices. The matching upstream GNU Go 2.6 source required by README_code is supplied as a managed supplement alongside it.
rights.notes: Original vers 128 identifies version 0.5, GNU Go engine 2.6, June 2001. Full 7392-byte README, 5318-byte README_code and 17977-byte COPYING reviewed. Source and resource notices are retained. Independent extraction matches all 37 paths, 74 forks and 37 Finder records, including resource-only apps and source resources. Strict KPK end 3413339, SHA-256 ec80ad1378b63564fcc5dbdf3c909e59de3d322c635e91102e2cbfec9462c4f8. Both original Go frontends remain in the archive; only the MacGnuGo GUI is verified, and this package is one game intake rather than two game counts.

rights.rights_holder: GNU Go authors / Free Software Foundation
rights.permission: Complete unchanged GNU Go 2.6 base source, accompanying the original Mac source files, patches and resources retained in the game archive. Preserve the original GNU COPYING and notices; supply this source download alongside the binary under GPLv2. No source is compiled or game binary modified.
rights.notes: Official GNU HTTPS download matches the integrity pin. Gzip/tar parses with 148 members under gnugo-2.6; configure metadata identifies 2.6 and required engine/interface source files are present. README_code specifically names 2.6 and warns against substituting 2.7.
